## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
Existing Xiaomi Mi automations using the platform specific services for humidifiers will break. Users need to change their automation to use the new services. Existing fan entities will be automatically replaced with new humidity entities.

The entity name is migrated from the fan entity name. The fan entity_id will change because the platform will change.
For the related entities the old fan entity name will be prepended to the new entities.

Example:
Entity with `entity_id` "fan.my_device" and `name` "My humidifier" will migrate to an entity with `entity_id` "humidifier.my_humidifier" and name "My humidifier".
A sensor for `humidity` will have a name like "My humidifier Humidity".

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The way Xiaomi Mi Humidifiers are supported has been changed. The fan platform has been updated, and the humidifiers moved to the humidifier platform, so now they are represented as humidifier entities.
The humidifier services are generic platform services now and no longer platform specific.
The existing fan attributes and services are implemented using the platforms `humidifier`, `sensor`, `switch`, `select` and `number`.


| Platform     | Service(s)                 | Related auto generated device entities                      |
|--------------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| `humidifier` | `set_humidity`, `set_mode` | Main device entity                                          |
| `switch`     | `turn_on`, `turn_off`      | `buzzer`, `child_lock`, `cleaning_mode` and `dry_mode`      |
| `sensor`     | _None_                     | `actual_speed`, `humidity`, `temperature` and `water_level` |
| `number`     | `set_value`                | `motor_speed`                                               |
| `select`     | `select_option`            | `led_brightness`                                            |

Hey there @rytilahti, @syssi, @starkillerog, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`xiaomi_miio`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L561) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Please use English as primary language.
Your issue translated:
> I noticed when the humidifier is disconnected from the mains that the temperature returns 0 ° but the humidity is reported as unknown. I think the return of unknown is better, because 0 ° delivers incorrect calculations, e.g. if you want to calculate the average. But basically I think 0 ° is misleading because this temperature is not applied.

Humidifiers will moved to the humidier platform. When the device is not seen on the net it will become inactive.
The humidity and termperature will be represented as a sensor from then.
Sensors will become unavailable if the device cannot be reached.

See PR https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/52366.
This PR should solve your issue.

review_comments: This is not being used only in this class, but on other classes deriving from `XiaomiCoordinatedMiioEntity`, so move it there are remove the extra implementations from all other classes.

As this function will be used by many other types of devices in the future to perform the initialization, can we have an if for the airhumidifiers, and raise an exception/log a warning when an unknown model is detected?
I cannot commit to this branch directly, all PR's in this branch were already approved. Please create a new PR against the rewok branch to request the changes you want.

For now async_create_miio_device_and_coordinator is not doing anything if a device is not a humidifier. An error is raised in get_platforms if a device is not supported.
As the flow is not anymore related only to the airpurifier, the URL should probably not point to syssi's `xiaomi_airpurifier`?
I cannot commit to this branch directly, all PR's in this branch were already approved. Please create a new PR against the rewok branch to request the changes you want.

> 
> 
> As the flow is not anymore related only to the airpurifier, the URL should probably not point to syssi's `xiaomi_airpurifier`?

Probably, so if you have a better idea, please submit so, because this URL was already here an I did not touch it, so it is not related to this PR.
Why change the docstring? Also, could/should this (and the other properties below) also be set as `_attr....`?
Create a `MODELS_HUMIDIFIER` containing these, that will make adding support for new humidifers much easier. Same applies to the CA4 below.

This is very, very specific for this single action. This class should be generalized to allow supporting any sort of "select" type of action.

Otherwise the code base will start piling up with similar, device-specific selectors for each and every single supported action supported and that will make the future maintainers very unhappy.

Soon enough other platforms (e.g., vacuum) should be converted to use separate sensors, so IMO this should simply state that the class holds information about a xiaomi_miio sensor. I'm not sure where the aqara even comes here, considering it's a completely separate code base?

There should be no separate setters for these, but all of it should be generalized. Different devices have different actions, but there should be no need to duplicate this (almost) very same code for each and every togglable function.

Just to give you some perspective: executing `ag 'def set_' miio/|wc -l` for the backend library yields 282 setters. Plenty of those belong to some specific devices that may be irrelevant (or are to be implemented by some other functions besides these specific service calls) but even then having a separate function for turning each property on as well as off makes an unsustainable overhead in the long run.
I cannot commit to this branch directly, all PR's in this branch were already approved. Please create a new PR against the rewok branch to request the changes you want.

> 
> Just to give you some perspective: executing `ag 'def set_' miio/|wc -l` for the backend library yields 282 setters. Plenty of those belong to some specific devices that may be irrelevant (or are to be implemented by some other functions besides these specific service calls) but even then having a separate function for turning each property on as well as off makes an unsustainable overhead in the long run.

I think we can reduce the number of specific setters by making the code more abstract, so e.g. moving more to the SERVICE_TO_METHOD part and using getattr(). For now there seems no need for this yet. I even took away some abstraction in the select and number platform, because there was only sevice.
